scope: Additive Monolith Arrow L1-27 recheck of official housing tiers, single-target damage, Queen assignment and unresolved projectile timing.
game_version: Official 2026-06-15 Anime Fury update; Goblins Farm claimed client build 18.600.3 updated 2026-09-16; immutable 2026-09-17 Monolith Arrow observation.

sources.title: THE ANIME FURY UPDATE IS HERE
facts: Monolith Arrow is Epic Archer Queen Equipment that fires a single-target arrow based on target maximum HP.
The published damage tiers are 14 percent at 0-180 deployed Housing Space, 10 percent at 181-250 and 5 percent at 251 or more.
Queen counts in deployed housing; Heroes count 25 each, Siege Machines count one; Pets, Clan Castle troops, spawned units and spells do not count.
The note says damage reduction is capped at 10 percent, troop spawns and reinforcements do not affect it, and projectile color reflects damage tier.
sources.limitations: The note does not define whether every normal Queen shot uses this effect, the activation mode, target classes, damage cap/rounding, projectile launch/impact timing, or the exact meaning of damage reduction.

sources.title: Have No Fear… Because The Anime Fury Medal Event is here!
facts: The June medal event advertised a power boost for Monolith Arrow shortly before the event ended.
sources.limitations: That temporary event boost is outside this goal and cannot be used as a permanent combat value.

sources.title: Monolith Arrow — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The public L1-27 Queen HP and ore-cost table matches the frozen 2026-09-17 observation, with HP bonus 100-1160.
sources.limitations: The public table omits activation classification, per-level projectile effects, target timing and damage-reduction semantics.

sources.title: Frozen Monolith Arrow level observation
sources.version: 2026-09-17 frozen observation from client build 18.400.21 as reported by publisher
facts: The immutable local observation has all 27 Queen HP, ore cost and Blacksmith requirement rows; the normalized catalogue retains these as data-only.
sources.limitations: The observation has no complete effect or projectile timing contract.

observations.note: The source does not specify damage integer rounding or the timing at which deployed Housing Space is sampled.

derivations.result: Expose Archer Queen assignment in the per-item coverage matrix
derivations.method: Read the sourced hero field on the frozen supplemental catalogue record as well as the raw-payload source_fields schema; no new combat behavior is inferred.

derivations.result: Retain all 27 Queen HP and cost rows as data-only
derivations.method: Recheck SHA-pinned 2026-09-17 observation against the dated 2026-09-16 public table.

derivations.result: Retain official 14/10/5 percent brackets and excluded unit classes as qualitative contract
derivations.method: Copy the official June 2026 table without inventing when housing is sampled or how maximum-HP damage is rounded.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the June medal-event Monolith Arrow boost in standard battles
rejected_inferences.reason: The boost was temporary event content and explicitly outside the user's goal.

rejected_inferences.rule: Infer active or passive classification from the official word 'Ability' alone
rejected_inferences.reason: The checked primary note does not say whether the arrow fires on every Queen attack or upon explicit activation.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the 10 percent damage-reduction cap as damage reduction received by the Queen
rejected_inferences.reason: The official wording does not identify the recipient or formula.

rejected_inferences.rule: Compute 14/10/5 percent from target maximum HP and round down
rejected_inferences.reason: Damage cap, defense modifiers, integer rounding and impact stage are not specified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use current Hero occupancy or army reserve when selecting a housing tier
rejected_inferences.reason: The source says deployed Housing Space; command effective time and snapshot sampling order are not defined.

rejected_inferences.rule: Reuse Giant Arrow line collision or projectile timing
rejected_inferences.reason: Monolith Arrow is a single-target projectile with no sourced shared geometry or speed contract.

items: active versus passive trigger and firing frequency
target eligibility, target choice, acquisition and loss
projectile launch, travel, impact, collision and tick order
housing count sample time and effect of prequeued deployments
max-HP percent arithmetic, caps, mitigation and integer rounding
meaning, recipient and duration of the 10 percent damage-reduction cap
Queen HP bonus stacking and other Equipment/Pet interactions
Viewer color tiers, asset rights, snapshot, replay and RL command contract

conclusion: Monolith Arrow L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official housing tiers and Queen assignment are source-backed, and all 27 HP rows are pinned. Trigger mode, damage-reduction meaning, projectile/target timing and damage arithmetic remain incomplete.
